scope: Local SDK native reuse review and equivalent replacements; source/price/history protection retained.

changes.result: Native schema, identity and seal validation replaces permissive completed-result parsing. Rejected seals do not fall back.
Removed AuditCheckpoints duplicate session writer and empty-worker completion override. Single portable SDK callback journal and read-only interim projection remain.
Removed host-defined subtask retry/takeover/checkpoint instructions. Chinese language, scope, exact source citation and source-read boundaries remain.
No dependency entry-path guess for the guidance helper.
Replace deprecated maxTimeHours alias; SDK pure validator confirms identical Deep limit. Standard advisory time is not substituted for the platform hard timeout.

Upload, immutable source snapshots, execution/source/credential binding
Cross-service queue, leases, Agent binding, cancellation, attempt history and result commit recovery
Credential isolation and fenced session refresh/revocation
Configured purchase prices, frozen historical pricing, cost ledger and platform token budgets
Validation Responses usage observation where the public SDK validate API lacks onUsage
Redacted interim evidence projection and a single portable callback journal
Evidence graph, frozen-source exact excerpt verification and pre-submit extraction/check
Report-body completeness, safe artifact delivery, secret-safe diagnostics and platform HTML/PDF/manual finding states

conditionalCompatibility: Third-party Responses input/namespace/model-catalog compatibility; native OpenAI bypasses this transport
Cross-process Retry-After coordination with SDK as the only model-request retry owner
Read-only native workbench phase/receipt observations absent from public callbacks
Pinned parent-state and Deep continuation bridge; no public SDK resume/state-transfer equivalent
Seven managed provider/V1 runtime compatibility patches and matching document fingerprints; not declared permanently required
